hero.desc: Over 25 years supporting Portuguese businesses with technology, management software, automation and specialist technical support.

story.title: A company built to last.
story.p1: InforAntunes began in 1997 in Lourinhã as a sole trader, at a time when business technology was taking its first steps in Portugal. In 2001, following the growth and consolidation of the business, the company InforAntunes was incorporated.
story.p2: Since then, we have grown alongside the companies we support, keeping pace with technological developments and new market demands. Throughout these years, one priority has continued to define how we work: delivering a high-quality, personal service focused on our clients’ results.
story.p3: Our model is simple: we combine leading technology with a close-knit, specialist team committed to every client’s success. More than supplying technology solutions, we seek to understand each business, identify its needs and build lasting partnerships.

items.title: Proximity
items.desc: We stay close to our clients — literally and strategically. Human engagement is a core part of our value proposition.

items.title: Expertise
items.desc: Over 25 years of accumulated experience in business technology, technical support and solution implementation.

items.title: Trust
items.desc: A relationship built over years with companies across different sectors, based on transparency and meeting commitments.

items.title: Innovation
items.desc: We follow market changes and introduce new technologies — such as automation and robotics — when they make sense for our clients.

items.title: Founded
items.desc: Founded in 1997 in Lourinhã as “CPM Informática”, focusing on restaurant software and IT support.

items.title: Solution expansion

items.title: PME Líder

items.title: Automated payments

items.title: Service robotics
